gaps.prev_text: We knew nothing of your Endless... your Dust... until
gaps.next_text: the rift ripped a path between our realities

gaps.prev_text: injecting a blight that spread like poison.
gaps.next_text: Our cosmos of order... and balance
Dying, corrupted and consumed... We had no choice

gaps.prev_text: Dying, corrupted and consumed... We had no choice
gaps.next_text: We are outcasts in the chaos that is your universe,

cues.text: Angular white rocks drift through a bright, misty void.
A dark mass pulses, its tendrils spreading outward.
White rocks tumble toward the pulsing black core.
A sleek, metallic spacecraft bursts from a swirling portal of white light into the dark void of space. Its hull is formed of segmented, floating geometric shapes, accented in red.
The segmented ship glides over the horizon of a ringed planet, heading toward the blazing light of a sun.

beats.note: A bright, misty white void filled with floating, angular white rocks.
A large white dodecahedron drifts among the smaller rocks.
A jagged black crack suddenly appears in the white void.
The black rift expands like twisting roots or veins.
Black tendrils shoot out and wrap around the white dodecahedron, corrupting it into a dark mass.
The corrupted black mass pulses, its tendrils spreading outward.
The black mass grows larger, a bright light shining from its center.
Looking up at the black mass, white rocks fall towards it.
The black mass consumes the white rocks, cracking them. White energy streams out of the center.
A sleek, metallic spaceship with red accents bursts out of a glowing portal into dark space. The ship is composed of floating segments.
The ship flies through the starry darkness.
The ship flies towards a bright star and a planet.
The ship flies past the planet, heading towards the blazing star.
